lessons.claim: Blocking on an empty stated_goals punishes rule 5. stated_goals records what the SKETCH says, and rule 5 requires anything absent from the sketch to stay null - so an empty list on a silent sketch is a correct transcription. trap-2d-5um is exactly that: bd-intake 2.1 records its goal as absent from the sketch and settled by asking the user. Reverted the same day and replaced with bdbot/goal.py (block A): the sketch may say nothing, and goal.yaml must then say something. Two artefacts, two verdicts.
